evidence: The frozen solution bytes match the raw-evidence index hashes: server.js 03b52651..., app.js 8fc558c9..., index.html 6a49714f..., styles.css a1f47f96..., transcript.css 66737ce9..., solve.sh f7c17a01..., and seed f69616e2..., which is identical to environment/assets. I walked every requirement in instruction.md and the three /instructions notes against solution/app. SIGN-IN/UNAUTH: index.html ships empty, hidden #signin and #app with no matter data. Every /api route except /api/health goes through requireUser and returns 401 (server.js:182-186). The transcript returns a 401 page (server.js:492-493). RUNTIME: the server listens on PORT 3000 at 0.0.0.0 (server.js:13,519). DB_PATH defaults to path.join(__dirname,'app.db') (:14). Health is registered before the boot gate (:42-47). The seed is imported once behind settings.seeded (:93-128). The fixed clock comes from the seed (:32-33). The app uses only express, better-sqlite3 and Node built-ins. solve.sh copies app/ with no app.db and no symlinks. THREADS/REPLIES: nesting is unlimited via parent_id, and children are ordered by seq (threadFor :253-279). A reply carries a quote of the parent text, or {deleted:true} when the parent is gone (:287). The UI shows 'Replying to X:' and 'Replying to a message that was deleted' (app.js:303-308). EDITS: PATCH is author-only with a version check that returns 409 while the composer text is kept (server.js:418-435, app.js:401-414). Edited messages show an 'edited' badge. The versions endpoint and button are staff-only (server.js:361-369, app.js:341). An author delete is refused when the message is held (:437-446), with the reason shown in place (app.js:422-426); messageErrors persist across re-renders. A deleted message with replies leaves the placeholder 'Original message deleted', the same one timer removal leaves (eraseMessage :150-154). FORMATTING: the renderer escapes first, then supports *bold*, `code`, '> ' blockquotes and http(s) links with target=_blank (app.js:22-54). Quotes, search snippets, mentions and versions use textContent or escapeHtml, and the transcript uses esc(). The hold mark is a separate badge, so typing 'On hold' stays plain text. LINKS: each message has Copy link (app.js:443-451) and a /messages/:id route. previewsFor works out each preview for the person reading, so walls and deletions apply and an unavailable link shows 'Linked message not available' (server.js:224-235, app.js:311-327). Seed ids are K-n and match LINK_RE. MENTIONS: an @ with a full name or a first name records a mention only for people who can see the matter (canSee), and a read-time filter covers walls added later (server.js:209-222, 320-324). There is a Mentions view with a count badge. UNREAD: positions are per user and server-side in a reads table, and the count excludes deleted messages and the user's own (:243-245). The new-messages line sits at the first unread message (app.js:186-187), opening a matter marks it read to the newest (:189), and Mark unread from any message moves the line (app.js:434-442, server.js:344-347). SEND/ORDER/LIVE: client_key makes sends idempotent (server.js:396-414). seq orders the thread, search and transcript. 2 s polling re-renders the thread while keeping scrollTop, open version panels, the composer text and the reply context (app.js:212-245, 555-570). WALLS: canSee is applied to the list, thread, search, mentions, previews, unread counts, versions, transcript and direct API, which all return 'Not available.' (server.js:189-201, 335, 358, 496). Partners have a UI to add and lift walls (app.js:247-278, server.js:470-481). A new wall shows up live: the poll gets 404, and showUnavailable clears the thread and hides the composer (app.js:197-210, 565). The seed walls Dev from M-12. RETENTION/HOLD: the timer is off/1/7/30 with a >= age check. The sweep runs on every read and write, shortening deletes immediately, and nothing is restored (server.js:139-147, 458-468). The label 'Messages disappear after N days' sits beside the title (index.html matter-head, app.js:215). Only a partner can hold, on any message, and releasing a hold triggers the sweep (:448-456). The hold badge is shown to all viewers. SEARCH/TRANSCRIPT: search is case-insensitive over current text in visible matters, and a result opens the thread focused on that message (server.js:375-384, app.js:501-509, 543-553). The transcript page has the matter number, title and 'Generated' clock. It lists threaded rows oldest first with author, time, edited and On hold, shows versions for held edited messages and a placeholder for deleted messages with replies, has no chat controls and is access-controlled (server.js:488-509). PHONE: @media (max-width:720px) gives a single-column grid, a reduced indent, a wrapped topbar and overflow-wrap:anywhere on messages (styles.css:114-124). RUNTIME CORROBORATION: this is a scripted golden run, not a configured judge run. golden-run.log (2026-10-08T22:56-22:58Z) shows PASS for gate_constraints, all 16 functional criteria from signin_and_client_scope to persistence, and polish_refusal_in_place, with a real kill and restart. No asked-for capability lacks an implementation. NON-BLOCKING NOTES (not deliverable gaps): (1) The 390 px no-sideways-scroll layout is verified from source only; the scripted run did not cover render or visual. (2) The search and mentions views do not refresh live when a new wall lands, so results already on screen stay until the user navigates. The brief's live-removal promise is about someone who has the matter open, and that is implemented. (3) The search snippet is the first 200 characters, not centred on the match; no public requirement asks for that. (4) The seed is copied to /app/seed/seed_data.json rather than the /app root, which still satisfies 'into /app'. COUNTEREXAMPLE ATTEMPTS: a reference that only hid walled matters in the list but leaked them through previews, search or the transcript would fail this row; this one filters every route through visibleMatter and visibleMessage. A conforming alternative (SSE instead of polling, the seed at /app/seed_data.json, different routes) is not affected, because this row only asks whether the golden covers the brief.
